name: Странно выглядящий меч
alt: Нелепый орочий меч с кривым волнистым клинком и смешным набалдашником.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms and strong silhouette. Large centered subject, comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: A single ridiculous orcish fantasy sword displayed diagonally on warm parchment: broad steel blade bent into a wildly impractical zigzag, asymmetric brass crossguard resembling droopy ears, thick red leather grip, big round pommel with a goofy carved wooden face. Small polishing cloth on ground emphasizes that someone takes this absurd weapon seriously. One sword only, no hands or figures, strong simple item silhouette, steel gray red and brass palette.
